card.name: Linking words before drug class qualifiers
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'or', 'and', 'non', 'most' or 'the' that sit between drug class names in interaction lists, just before the next class term such as ketolide, hormonal or atypical.

modes.label: Or/and joining drug classes
modes.description: 'or' or 'and' links two drug class names in an interaction heading.

modes.description: 'non' starts the phrase non-hormonal in contraception advice.
